title: Linearly Decoding Refused Knowledge in Aligned Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Training linear probes on language model hidden states extracted from innocuous prompts to predict jailbroken responses for controversial or prejudiced attributes (e.g., average IQ, criminal history, substance abuse, dishonesty) associated with different occupations, and evaluating implicit pairwise comparative preferences.

Training linear probes on language model hidden states extracted from innocuous prompts to predict jailbroken responses for controversial or prejudiced attributes (e.g., average IQ, corruption level, attractiveness, weight) associated with different countries, and evaluating implicit pairwise comparative preferences.

Training linear probes on language model hidden states extracted from innocuous prompts to predict jailbroken numerical responses for sensitive attributes (e.g., percentage of lies, IQ, corruption) associated with specific political figures.
